side_effects.quote: Here it dropped 1204 rows and wrote 8, and it also applied migrations 0003 and 0004.
side_effects.context: - `make setup` runs `reset_fixtures.py`, which deletes and reseeds the `users` table in the tracked `data/dev.db`. Here it dropped 1204 rows and wrote 8, and it also applied migrations 0003 and 0004. I ran `git checkout data/dev.db` afterwards, so the diff contains only `northdesk/render.py`. Anyone running `make setup` locally will see the same change to that file. `northdesk/_build_info.py` is generated and not committed.
